name: Foursquare Places
tagline: Global venue search, place details, and location data for apps
description: Foursquare Places API provides venue search, place details, categories, tips, photos, and geolocation data across millions of points of interest worldwide. Developers use it for location-based discovery, local business info, and place enrichment in consumer and enterprise apps.

auth.details: API key via Authorization header (Bearer or raw key); self-serve developer signup

use_cases: search nearby restaurants or coffee shops by query and coordinates
get place details, hours, and contact info by Foursquare ID
autocomplete place names as a user types a location query
find venues by category near a lat/lng
enrich addresses or coordinates with venue metadata
